verdict.rationale: Cursor's agents clearly take on hands-off coding work. They build and test features end to end, run checks before merge, and fix and maintain software on schedules or triggers; the Cookbook ships CI auto-fix bots. The docs also show an agent updating Node.js version constraints across a project, which covers dependency updates. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of resolving merge conflicts, explicit documentation of the agent writing new tests or fixing lint errors (only implied by 'build, test' and 'run checks'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of these tasks.
